chapter_title: The Interpretation of Happiness, Wisdom and Power;
spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation

---

**¶5:**

The blessedness of the Divine Itself is the Inmost, the God of [GAP-1: REVIEW — divine truth, who] is established in the infinite state of [GAP-2: REVIEW — divine wisdom]. The proceeding divine truth is the Divine Proceeding that [GAP-3: — descends into what is below], which flows as influx through all degrees of spiritual order, and all those degrees are sustained within it. The Divine omnipotence is all capacities of good, all abundances of truth, and all forms of celestial ministry that proceeded forth from the Divine, as they [GAP-4: — came into distinct being], they that are called discrete degrees of spiritual life [GAP-5: — within the Divine order].

---

**¶6:**

[GAP-6: — The containing form] which is called divine love [GAP-7: — that is, the vessel of] love in its active and transforming power, [GAP-8: — in which dwells the mediating] Principle of the Divine Proceeding, the second degree of divine fullness [GAP-9: — in descending order. The] glorious [GAP-10: REVIEW — blessedness] is the [GAP-11: REVIEW — Active] Divine Proceeding at work in creation, [GAP-12: — and the proceeding divine truth] is the receptive matrix from which all spiritual life is generated [GAP-13: — into being; and the Divine omnipotence] is [GAP-14: REVIEW — all] the capacities of good, [GAP-15: REVIEW — all] the abundances of truth, and all forms of celestial ministry that are contained within the vessel of divine love.

---

**¶7:**

Again, blessedness, divine truth, and omnipotence exist in the containing vessel of divine truth [GAP-16: — in its living and flowing form]. The blessedness [GAP-17: — in this vessel is] the Divine Understanding of the Inmost. Also, the proceeding truth is the pure, uncorrupted Wisdom of the Divine in its virginal and unreceived state. And the omnipotence that is in this vessel is [GAP-18: REVIEW — all] the capacities of good, the abundances of truth, and the celestial forms of ministry that are established within it.

---

**¶8:**

Again, these three exist in the constitutive principles of created order itself: blessedness, divine truth, and omnipotence. The blessedness is [GAP-19: REVIEW — the sustaining axis of divine order], the complete Human Form through which all of heaven is configured. The proceeding divine truth is the [GAP-20: REVIEW — five discrete faculties of] the Active Divine Proceeding in operation; and the Divine omnipotence [GAP-21: — is constituted by the fi]ve fundamental affections of good from the Divine Human [GAP-22: — which are interwov]en and present throughout all of created reality, so that [GAP-23: — the whole is held in being] while the Divine Human sustains the totality of creation.

---

### Note on the structure

The teaching unfolds the same triune reality — blessedness (the good of love), wisdom (the truth of that love), and power (the capacity to act from both) — across four descending degrees: the Inmost Divine (¶5), the vessel of divine love (¶6), the vessel of divine truth (¶7), and the constitutive order of creation itself (¶8). This is precisely the law of discrete degrees: the same divine life repeats its form at every level, from inmost to ultimate, each degree a containing vessel for the life that proceeds from above.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: [The happin]ess of the glorious one is the Father, the God of [truth, who] is established in the great land of [light]. His glorious wis[d]om is his Great Spirit that [extends to what is] below, which flows through all his aeons, and t[h]ey float therein. His great power is all the gods, the rich ones and the angels who were summoned from him as they [came forth] they that are called aeons [of the greatness]

[Again, the ship] which is called the sun [that is, the ship of] living fire, [in which dwells the Third Amba]ssador, the second greatne[ss in order. The] glorious [happiness] is the [Living] Spirit, [the great one. Also, the wisdom] is the Mother of Lif[e. And great power] is [all] the gods, [the] rich ones and the angels who are within the ship.

Again, [h]appiness, wisdom and power exist in the s[hip of liv]ing waters [which is the moon.] the happiness [therein is] the Mind of the Father. Also, wisdom [is the Vir]gin of [Li]ght. And the power that is [i]n the ship is [all] the go[ds], the [ri]ch ones and the angels who are established i[n it].

Again, these three exist in the elements: happiness, wis[d]om and power. The happiness is [the Pillar of Glory], the Perfect Man. Wisdom is the [five sons of the] Living Spirit; and great powe[r is the fi]ve sons of the First Man [his armour, who are encl]osed and compounded in the totality, that [all things endure] while he supports the totality.

fills.explanation: The Father of Greatness is consistently called the God of Truth in Manichaean cosmology, and the spiritual reading confirms "divine truth, who" — the editor's choice is correct.
The "great land of light" is the standard Manichaean designation for the divine realm, corresponding to the infinite state of divine wisdom in the spiritual reading.
The spiritual reading says "descends into what is below"; the Great Spirit extends downward to what is below, flowing through all aeons — expressing the Divine Proceeding reaching into lower degrees.
The spiritual reading says "came into distinct being"; gods, rich ones and angels "came forth" from the Divine — the standard Manichaean language for emanation from the Father.
The spiritual reading says "within the Divine order"; "aeons of the greatness" is the standard Kephalaia formula for the discrete degrees of divine life emanated from the Father of Greatness.

The spiritual reading says "The containing form which is called divine love"; paralleling ¶7's introduction ("Again, happiness, wisdom and power exist in the ship of living waters"), ¶6 introduces the sun ship as the next descending vessel.
The spiritual reading says "that is, the vessel of"; this identifies the sun by its cosmological title — "the sun, that is, the ship of living fire" — standard Kephalaia appositive construction.

fills.fill: in which dwells the Third Amba
fills.explanation: The spiritual reading says "in which dwells the mediating Principle"; the Third Ambassador is the divine entity who dwells in the sun ship in Manichaean cosmology, serving as the mediating principle of the Divine Proceeding.

The spiritual reading says "in descending order"; "the second greatness in order" designates the Third Ambassador's rank in the descending series of divine emanations, then transitions to the new statement about happiness.
The spiritual reading confirms "blessedness"; "happiness" is the consistent term used throughout this chapter for the first attribute of the trine at each degree — the editor's choice is correct.

The spiritual reading confirms "Active Divine Proceeding"; the Living Spirit is the standard Manichaean entity representing the active divine power at work in cosmic creation — the editor's choice is correct.

fills.fill: the great one. Also, the wisdom
fills.explanation: The spiritual reading transitions from the Active Divine Proceeding to "the proceeding divine truth"; the Living Spirit receives the epithet "the great one," then "Also, the wisdom" introduces the second attribute, paralleling ¶7's "Also, wisdom is the Virgin of Light."

The spiritual reading says "into being; and the Divine omnipotence"; "Life" is completed, then "And great power" transitions to the third attribute of the trine, following the chapter's consistent pattern.
The spiritual reading confirms "all"; this matches the consistent formula across all four degrees: "power is all the gods, the rich ones and the angels."
The standard Kephalaia formula is "all the gods, the rich ones and the angels" — the article "the" before "rich ones" is confirmed by the identical phrasing in ¶5 and ¶7.

The spiritual reading says "in its living and flowing form"; the ship of living waters is identified as the moon in Manichaean cosmology, paralleling ¶6 where the ship of living fire is called the sun.

The spiritual reading says "in this vessel is"; "therein" locates the happiness attribute within the moon ship, yielding "the happiness therein is the Mind of the Father" — the blessedness residing in this particular vessel.
The spiritual reading confirms "all"; this maintains the invariant formula for the power attribute across all four degrees: "all the gods, the rich ones and the angels."

The spiritual reading says "the sustaining axis of divine order"; the Pillar of Glory (Column of Glory) is the Manichaean entity that sustains all creation in its ultimate degree, identified with the Perfect Man — confirming the editor's choice.

The spiritual reading says "five discrete faculties of the Active Divine Proceeding"; the five sons of the Living Spirit are the standard Manichaean entities representing wisdom's operative faculties in cosmic construction.

The spiritual reading says "is constituted by the five"; at the level of elements, power is identified directly with the five sons of the First Man — the five light elements trapped in matter — completing "power is the five sons."

The spiritual reading says "which are interwoven"; the five sons of the First Man are regularly called "his armour" in the Kephalaia, designating the five light elements he bore into battle that are now enclosed in matter.

The spiritual reading says "the whole is held in being"; "all things endure while he supports the totality" expresses how the Perfect Man / Pillar of Glory sustains creation in its ultimate natural degree — Swedenborg's Maximus Homo holding all in existence.
